divergences.what: getRageTier returns only the bonus tier; tireless rage is a separate hasTirelessRage() flag
divergences.why: Tireless rage at 17 removes post-rage fatigue but keeps greater rage bonuses, so it is not a bonus tier

divergences.what: Gate implemented as a generic getFastMovementBonus() driven by the classes.json gate flags
divergences.why: Monk carries the same shape with a stricter flag; its branch is wired in Plan C, not here

divergences.what: Rage temp HP is reported by getRageTempHp, not added; the boosted Con already raises getMaxLife
divergences.why: Adding level x 2 on top of the Con bonus would double-count the same hit points

divergences.what: endRage skips the Fatigued condition at level 17+
divergences.why: Tireless rage removes the post-rage fatigue per the SRD and the rules notes

divergences.what: Added onUseClassFeature, onResetClassFeature and onToggleRage to playerSheetThunks.js
divergences.why: The card must persist through Redux; the two generic thunks are reused by steps 8 and 10

divergences.what: Extended class_feature_cards.test.js for the Barbarian entry
divergences.why: Its no-cards list asserted Barbarian returns nothing, which the new registration invalidates

divergences.what: getClassBonusFeatSlotsMax is data-driven, so Wizard and Monk report their own bonus slots too
divergences.why: classes.json already carries bonusFeatLevels for both; Plan C reuses this helper verbatim

divergences.what: Added getGeneralFeatsUsed() alongside the two helpers the step names
divergences.why: Step 6 must show a general used count and may not compute it in the UI per CLAUDE.md

divergences.what: Added hasClassBonusFeatPool() to the model and gated the second budget on it
divergences.why: Wizard and Monk grant slots with no qualifying flag, so they would show an unfillable 0 of N pool

divergences.what: The SRD turning check table lives as TURN_UNDEAD_TABLE in player.js, not in classes.json
divergences.why: It is a shared sub-system table, not a per-class value; follows the monkUnarmedDamage precedent

divergences.what: Extended class_feature_cards.test.js again for the Cleric and Paladin entries
divergences.why: Its no-cards list asserted both return nothing, which the new registrations invalidate

divergences.what: getRemoveDiseaseMax follows the SRD table (1 at level 6, +1 every 3) not the criterion's 1 + floor(level/6)
divergences.why: The criterion formula grants a use at level 1; the SRD and classes.json both start it at 6th
Step 10 must display +Cha to attack and +level to damage, which is model logic per CLAUDE.md

divergences.what: Each paladin card also self-gates on its own max being above zero
divergences.why: A Cha 10 paladin has no lay on hands pool at all, so the card would otherwise render 0 of 0
